title: nds-mcp: Nuclear Data Services MCP server
description: nds-mcp is an offline SQLite-backed MCP server for nuclear data. It exposes atomic masses (AME2020), nuclear properties and decay data (NUBASE2020), charge radii, ENSDF levels, gamma transitions and decay feedings, TUNL light-nuclei levels, JENDL-5 cross sections and radiation spectra, EXFOR data points, and CODATA fundamental constants through a uniform tool interface. Values are source-tagged: when a quantity exists in several sources, every source value is returned together with a recommended value rather than a silent merge. This release is a metadata and citation release and has no functional changes. The data assets (nds.sqlite.gz, jendl5.sqlite.gz, exfor.sqlite.gz, fendl32c.sqlite.gz, irdff2.sqlite.gz) are distributed through GitHub Releases and are not part of this source archive.
